title: vpc: implement tenant-scoped egress-tier allocator and DNS routing optimizer
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds a tenant-scoped egress tier allocator and an associated DNS routing optimizer for private control plane deployments. Motivation: customers running multiple tenant control planes in a single VPC were encountering noisy-neighbour egress hotspots and inconsistent DNS forwarding behavior during rolling upgrades. The change bundles a small terraform module (egress-tier) plus helm chart hooks and an operator-style reconciliation loop to: 1) allocate zone-aware egress tiers (EIP pools + NAT opt-in) per tenant boundary, 2) attach scoped security groups and route table associations, 3) create conditional Route53 forwarding rules with prioritized target lists to optimize DNS resolution during peering and endpoint failover, and 4) add safe rollback hooks to unwind ephemeral EIP allocations and remove transient route table entries. The description below lists the core pieces and reasoning. Implementation notes: - Terraform: a new module egress_tier/ creates AutoAllocatedEipPool, TierSecurityGroup, and route-table stubs with annotations for staged rollouts. It exposes an allocation_id and a list of candidate ENIs for AZ-aware attachment. The module is intentionally small and idempotent (reconcile pattern uses tags & name constraints). - Helm: values.yaml additions allow installer to enable per-tenant egress tiers via controlplane. The chart template adds pre-upgrade hooks that mark routes as "staged" and post-upgrade hooks that perform allocation promotion. - Installer operator: a lightweight controller (installer/egresstier) reconciles the Terraform allocation outputs with Kubernetes CRs. On create it ensures SGs and ENI attachments follow AZ affinity and writes a stable lease annotation to avoid double-allocations during concurrent upgrades. - DNS routing optimizer: when peering changes or endpoint failovers are detected, the operator updates Route53 conditional forwarding with a short-lived TTL and prioritized targets (local endpoint -> regional proxy -> fallback privatelink). This minimizes blackhole windows during canary rollouts across regions. Rollback behavior: the controller supports a two-phase decommission: (1) demote allocation by removing it from prefixlists, and (2) a sweep that deletes EIPs only after leases expire. The helm hooks also support a --dry-run annotation for smoke testing. Backwards compatibility: the feature is opt-in and disabled by default. Existing installs see no behavioral changes until values.enableTenantEgress = true. Linear links and tests are provided.

review_comments: Arjun Patel (2025-02-19): Can you add an idempotency test for concurrent allocations? In particular, ensure two installers starting at similar times don't allocate overlapping EIPs. -- Requested change.
Maya Chen (2025-02-20): Added lease_manager test and introduced a stable tag format to prevent collisions. See tests/integration/egress_tier_end_to_end.sh lines 40-90. -- Author reply.
Sofia Alvarez (2025-02-21): The helm pre-upgrade hook's timeout might be too short for large accounts. Suggest increasing default to 10m and making it configurable. -- Comment.
Maya Chen (2025-02-22): Increased timeout to 10m and exposed helm.values.egressTier.hookTimeout. Updated charts/README.md accordingly. -- Author reply.
Liam O'Connor (2025-02-23): Approved after verification on staging where the DNS failover behaved as expected and no EIP leakage was observed. -- Approval.
merge_outcome: merged using squash (merged_at: 2025-02-27). Merge commit: squash of 7 commits into main. Changelog: Add tenant-scoped egress tier module, installer operator, helm flags and DNS routing optimizer.
release_notes: Opt-in tenant-scoped egress tiers and DNS routing optimizer. Enables per-tenant EIP pools and prioritized Route53 forwarding to reduce DNS blackholes during peering/upgrade. Disabled by default; enable via helm values: controlplane.egressTier.enabled=true. Includes safe rollback scripts and lease-based decommissioning.
testing_notes: Integration tested in staging across two AZs. Test harness validates concurrent allocation, forced endpoint failover, and dry-run hook. Manual canary on customer sandbox passed under SRE oversight. Load test: 1k rps for DNS updates with TTL=30s showed stable convergence within 12s.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: leaking EIPs on abrupt controller termination. Mitigation: lease TTL plus periodic sweeper job and scripts/rollback/egress_decommission.sh to forcibly reclaim stale allocations. Configurable safety window defaults to 12 hours.
migration_steps: 1) Upgrade installer chart with egressTier.enabled=false to pick up operator binaries. 2) Enable egressTier for tenant namespace and monitor allocation events. 3) Promote allocations during low-traffic window. 4) If rollback required run scripts/rollback/egress_decommission.sh. Detailed steps in docs/operator/egress-tier.md.
